5.heading: the king of the Ammonites:
refs: We find here, that he brought the Ammonites under a heavy tribute for three years
but whether this was the effect of his prevailing against them, is not so evident. Some think that they paid this tribute for three years, and then revolted
that, in consequence, he attacked them, and their utter subjection was the result. 2Ch 20:1
Rather, "ten thousand cors (korim ) of wheat." The cor was same as the homer, and contained about 32 pecks 1 pint.
